historical_record.description: The Russian branch of the International Institute worked from this address, helping Russian immigrants with interpreting, naturalisation and meeting space.
The Cosmos Club, the most prestigious of the city's Black social clubs and open to people of all races, met monthly at the offices of the International Institute here. The building is gone.
The City Planning Commission refused, 6-0, a 12-unit residential building 48.5 feet tall, above the 40-foot limit of the RM-3 district (Resolution 8477).
